packet.headline_seed: California to begin ticketing driverless cars that violate traffic laws
packet.description_seed: Under the new rules, police will be able to issue tickets directly to the car's manufacturer when an autonomous vehicle breaks a traffic law.

what: California to begin ticketing driverless cars that violate traffic laws

clean_source_blocks.text: Under the new rules, police will be able to issue tickets directly to the car's manufacturer when an autonomous vehicle breaks a traffic law.
Driverless cars are becoming more common in some California cities, but when the autonomous vehicles violate traffic laws, police haven't been able to ticket them - until now.
California police officers will soon be able to issue traffic tickets to driverless cars and require manufacturers to move them out of the way during emergencies.
When the vehicles violate traffic laws, some police have been stumped as to how to hold the driverless cars accountable.

packet.source_text:
Under the new rules, police will be able to issue tickets directly to the car's manufacturer when an autonomous vehicle breaks a traffic law.

Driverless cars are becoming more common in some California cities, but when the autonomous vehicles violate traffic laws, police haven't been able to ticket them - until now.

California police officers will soon be able to issue traffic tickets to driverless cars and require manufacturers to move them out of the way during emergencies.

When the vehicles violate traffic laws, some police have been stumped as to how to hold the driverless cars accountable.
